prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE landscape about3:2 ASTELLA animated OBJECT-BOSS key scene in its arena, no sheet, no panels, no captions or UI. Input images are Part1 Campanella STYLE/MATERIAL REFERENCES ONLY: polished clean2D anime fantasy concept art, broad ivory-white and navy ENAMEL mechanical forms, pale gold bevels, restrained lavender cel shading, strong coherent silhouette. DO NOT COPY THE BELL, CLOAK OR SPIDER LEGS from references. Scene atmosphere may be dark but the functional object is readable. No photoreal gritty metal, no microgear clutter, no fabric. The ENTIRE dominant subject is a freestanding inanimate apparatus that has come alive, NEVER a person or person-shaped robot. ZERO human presence anywhere: no people, faces, eyes, mouths, noses, heads, hair, beards, skin, facial masks, dolls, mannequins, humanoid statues, human torso/waist/shoulders, arms/hands/fingers/shoes, military uniforms, capes, dresses, person armor, portraits or reflections of people. Emotion comes ONLY from load, mechanical resistance, erosion and setting. One dominant object with all its major structural parts and clock-hand spine INSIDE frame, scenery may extend out. No extra solid bosses, no labels, no watermarks.
Subject: ONE colossal LOAD-BEARING ASTROLABE MACHINE. Main silhouette is a wide TRIANGULAR ENGINEERING SCAFFOLD with three low floor-anchor plates in tripod arrangement, thick ivory/navy/gold lattice beams, and a very large OPEN circular roller-bearing hub set diagonally within scaffold. The toroidal bearing visibly has rollers and structural axle joints, no face-like layout. NO central bust/head and no standing human outline. Three anchor plates are flat industrial machine skids, not feet or animal legs.
A huge GOLDEN HOUR-HAND SPEAR-SHAPED STRUT is integrated as its diagonal structural spine: broad tapered clock-hour-hand blade at upper end, heavy continuous shaft through keyed bearing, lower end bolted into foremost floor-anchor. It physically supports the underside of an enormous collapsing cracked celestial ring/ceiling slab above the bearing. The hourhand is a LOAD-BEARING COLUMN, NOT a held weapon. Show the contact point, brace linkage and bending strain clearly. Spear top point, shaft and lower anchor fully framed.
On opposing sides of the hub are TWO LARGE MACHINE CALIPERS with thick simple C-shaped housings and rectangular brake pads, mechanically mounted directly to bearing flanges. One caliper tries to rotate/release the strut while the opposite caliper is jammed against its lock-block to PREVENT the destructive release. Two opposed steel brake mechanisms resisting one another; not arms or fingered grippers. Readable complete mounts and hinges, one coherent object, no floating disconnected appendages.
Scene:45m black obsidian circular STAR-CHART arena, first four floor-hour markers broken/dark while later arc markers glow cold blue. Immense coherent brass astrolabe rings and frozen midnight cosmos behind; a few large broken star-chart slabs. The celestial ceiling arc visibly bends down ONTO the machine rather than hovering far away. Low three-quarter cinematic camera, machine large in foreground, triangular base spread wide, spine oblique under weight. Express the last protective resistance through buckling joints, taut braces, opposing locked calipers and pale gold stress cracks, no expression or character accessories. Use ivory/navy/gold solid color shapes, cold blue cosmic backdrop, limited readable mechanical details.
